liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears it as capturing the sound of the band's early days; Reviewer finds it extremely catchy; also praises Phil's sweet, strong singing [9][11]
- **Caution** (1 review): Reviewer calls this version hot [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Can't Come Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Mindbender**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [14]
- **The Only Time Is Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Early Morning Rain**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [14]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Caution, I Know You Rider [14]

## The recordings

- **gd65-11-03.sbd.vernon.9044.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 6 songs; 18 min; rated 4.38/5 by 112 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer likes the old, low-quality sound of the recording, finding it trippy and clearly of 1965; Sound quality is surprisingly good for a recording nearly 40 years old; Sound is remarkably good for its age [3][7][8][9]

## Around the show

- Recording is an Autumn Records demo made under the name The Warlocks [1]
- On this demo the band used the name The Emergency Crew because another band already held The Warlocks [4]
- Reviewer notes how far the band has traveled musically in the forty years since this recording [8]
- Reviewer finds the 1960s Dead sound very different from the band's later years [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd65-11-03.sbd.vernon.9044.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Raoul Duke and Matt Vernon; source: Soundboard [1]
